Seeing a human being that seems competent gives me a way better feeling than some kind of animation. Or even worse, a (AI?) generated Avatar. It just gives me the strong urge to avoid or even go against a generated or Avatar-sourced recommendation/ advise. Maybe because I personally value human exchange and interaction alot and fear that our society mostly focusses on digitalisation in the wrong fields or extend. I feel like that often results in more damage (towards our society) than help. E.g. loss of jobs, higher need of energy and limited ressources (environmental consequences).
